title: Chat replies in plain text (0.6.8, decision #66)
head: fix/chat-plain-text
body:
Braden: chat replies looked cluttered. His choice (decision #66) is plain text with line breaks kept. desktop-app#10 (merged) keeps the breaks; this PR stops the model from sending Markdown.

- `DEFAULT_CHAT_INSTRUCTIONS` in `local_service_adapters.py`: the existing data-not-instructions rule, plus "Reply in plain text: no Markdown… short paragraphs… `- ` list items". Production uses this default.
- Version 0.6.7 → 0.6.8.
- Links: `Btabor11/` → `RDW-Labz/` in AGENTS.md, README.md and vendor/PROVENANCE.md (decision #65).

**Test:** `test_default_chat_instructions_ask_for_plain_text` checks that the default adapter's system message is the new constant, asks for plain text and no Markdown, and still has the data-not-instructions rule.
